command: Human AP3M2 P53677, the mu3B AP-3 subunit, retains trans-Golgi localization, Golgi-to-vacuole/lysosome trafficking, clathrin-adaptor-complex membership, clathrin-cargo adaptor activity and AP-3-dependent clathrin cargo loading, and AP-3-complex binding. Evaluate each separately using actual GO definitions and target/ortholog assays, distinguishing general cargo selection from specifically clathrin-dependent endocytic assembly. Actual PTHR10529 tree target PTN002540363 descends from family-root PTN000055849 (TGN, Golgi-vacuole and clathrin-cargo IBD) through AP-3 node PTN002237676; the recovered AP2 TGN-loss node and other transport-loss node are outside this path. Broad ancestral placement must be examined, not rejected because extant seeds include AP1/AP4. Primary9545220 reports beta3 clathrin binding and cellular colocalization; full primary39705307 explicitly discusses both clathrin-dependent and independent AP3 functions and states clathrin inhibition does not FULLY disrupt AP3 traffic. Its 9C5B human structure is AP3M1 Q9Y2T2, NOT AP3M2; existing reproducible alignment transfers 8/9 cargo-contact residues plus conservative V405I. Primary15051738 localizes AP3 to tubular endosomes; determine whether it excludes conditional TGN action or principally identifies a major route. Primary34688652 is yeast AP3 Golgi reconstitution, not direct human AP3M2 evidence. Primary9748267 directly assays mu3A/mu3B tyrosine-signal selection, and11588176 shows neuronal AP3 endosomal vesicle budding. AP3-complex-binding source mouse Q8R2R9 has IDA19010779; read the full cross-linking/MS experiments and do not presume the GO binding definition requires an external ligand. Absence of a human-specific assay, constitutive subunit status or clathrin-independent competence alone is not refutation. Distinguish genuine term-scope problems, supported condition-specific capacity and unresolved evidence.
